title: benkara hoaensis
intro: Benkara hoaensis, commonly known as the Khasi hill benkara, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its traditional uses in folk medicine, where it is believed to possess various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Benkara hoaensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities. These properties make Benkara hoaensis a potential natural remedy for the treatment of various diseases and conditions, including oxidative stress, diabetes, and certain types of cancer.
